create_placement_shard: create a Shard placement to shard a tensor along a specified dimension across devices
create_placement_replicate: create a Replicate placement to replicate a tensor across all devices in a mesh
create_placement_partial: create a _Partial placement with a reduce operation for pending reductions on a mesh dimension
build_dtensorspec_from_dim_map: build a DTensorSpec from a device mesh, dim map, and pending sums list
test_dtensorspec_dim_map: test the DTensorSpec dim_map property to verify tensor dimensions map to device mesh dimensions
